observations: Outdoor (condenser) unit of a split air conditioner, dust-covered, sitting on tiled floor.
Copper refrigerant pipes are insulated with white foam wrap, coiled loosely and disconnected from any wall or system.

identity.kind: split air conditioner outdoor condenser unit (scrap/parts)

claims.claim: Scrap split AC condenser unit, sold as is for parts, repair or recycling
claims.evidence: photo 0 shows disconnected wiring, cut pipes, and general disuse consistent with a non-functional scrap unit
logistics arrangement, not visible in any photo

risks.risk: Compressor could be seized, burnt, or missing entirely (common in 'scrap' listings)
risks.proof: A photo/clip of the compressor nameplate and a power-on test showing it running or humming
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-working scrap, compressor value excluded

risks.risk: Copper tubing/coils may have been partially stripped or be low-grade aluminum fin-copper tube, affecting scrap/recycling value
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the coil fins and pipe joints showing copper content and length intact
risks.if_unproven: priced at low-end scrap weight estimate, assuming partial copper only

risks.risk: Unknown tonnage/capacity (1HP, 1.5HP, 2HP) which affects scrap weight and resale value
risks.proof: A clear photo of the nameplate/label on the side or back of the unit
risks.if_unproven: priced at smallest common capacity assumption

risks.risk: Unit may be missing the fan motor or have internal rot/rust not visible from this angle
risks.proof: Photo of the rear/fan side and a video of the fan blade and motor
risks.if_unproven: priced as if fan motor is missing or seized

proof_requests: Nameplate/label photo for capacity and brand
Close-up of coil and pipe joints to assess copper content
Short power-on test clip (if any power source available) to check compressor/fan function
Photo of the rear side showing the fan and motor
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a scrap/non-functional split AC outdoor unit, consistent with the seller's own description, so it can be priced at worst-case scrap/parts value without further proof.
